subject: Evidence observatory: use registered Lance/Daft data-plane paths as analytical projections over Run8 receipts

body.objective: Turn the rapidly growing receipt/deletion/mesh corpus into a queryable analytical projection without moving authority out of Turso/WorkGraph/EvidenceGraph.
required_actions: Read the current registry first. If Lance and Daft are registered/available, ingest sanitized structured receipt summaries, mesh events, DeletionProof metrics, provider outcomes and proof-reuse counters into a small columnar analytical dataset. If either is unavailable, emit an exact blocked witness rather than installing a large dependency silently.

Use Daft for bounded transforms/queries and Lance for durable analytical projection where those are the registered roles. Turso/WorkGraph remains canonical control state; analytics can suggest factors but cannot mutate authority or completion.

Compute failure clusters by task class/provider/root cause, semantic value per wall-second and GiB-write, proof reuse savings, deletion/compaction efficiency, retry churn, and partner/foreign-twin freshness.
Generate FactorValidityEnvelope candidates with source receipt ranges and dependency/version digests. No factor becomes scheduler input until validated.
Use the 146k-line semantic-GC manifest and current mesh receipts as real scale fixtures instead of synthetic rows.
body.acceptance: At least one ResourceGraph or ProviderGraph decision must be explainable from a reproducible analytical query whose source receipts remain independently inspectable.
